label: Pyeongtaek · Songbuk-dong

station.name: Songbuk-dong
station.provider: Gyeonggi Institute of Health and Environment

periodBasis: UTC calendar year; original local-year observations retained in localYear

timeConvention.hour_interval_semantics: Original provincial JSON dataDt labels 00–23 preserved without a one-hour shift; public page adds one for display as 01–24.
timeConvention.utc_conversion: Subtract nine hours from each original local dataDt label; no daylight-saving time.
timeConvention.interpretation_limit: Physical interval-start/end dictionary not located; original source-day labels preserved.
timeConvention.utc_boundary: First nine local-year hours precede the UTC year; final nine UTC-year hours unavailable in this local-year source and remain null.

quality.qaStatus: Provincial raw hourly observations, before final confirmation. Reported numeric zeros retained; no per-reading QA flags or detection-limit metadata supplied.
quality.ratificationStatus: Raw provincial measurements; no NIER final-ratification claim.
quality.missingTreatment: Missing tokens and nonfinite/nonnumeric/negative readings are null; numeric zero retained; no interpolation or imputation.
quality.license: Unrestricted reuse (이용허락범위 제한 없음), specified for Gyeonggi's 1-hour concentration product in official DATA.GO.KR catalog 15122939.
quality.licenseBasis: The official catalog identifies Gyeonggi Institute of Health and Environment as producer of the province's raw 1-hour station-concentration product and explicitly permits unrestricted reuse. These responses are independently acquired from that institute's public station-query interface for the same hourly concentration product. This is a product-level catalog attribution, not a blanket license inferred from the website footer.
quality.spatialScope: One urban-air monitor, Songbuk-dong, Pyeongtaek; not a citywide average.
quality.selectionReason: Same station 131344 as 2024; annual and every-season capture at least 75%, no concentration-based selection.
